## Summary

**Issue:** checkout-api was unhealthy on v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rollback:** Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** — the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first attempt partially failed (only us-east completed before an orchestrator error halted the rollout), but a retry succeeded across all regions.
2. **Verification:** Service is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all three regions, with error rate back down to ~0.2%.
3. **Incident:** Opened **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api describing the failure, the rollback (including the partial-failure/retry), and the confirmed healthy state. On-call has been paged.
